# CloudTyke Azure emulator: coverage matrix

<!-- Generated by `make coverage` from the registered resource providers. Do not edit by hand. -->

Anything not listed here returns `501 NotImplemented` with the resource type and api-version.
With `CLOUDTYKE_STRICT_API_VERSIONS=true` only the api-versions listed are accepted.

## Azure Resource Manager

| Resource type | API versions | Phase | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Microsoft.Authorization/permissions` | 2022-04-01, 2015-07-01 | 1 | effective permissions of the caller at a scope |
| `Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments` | 2022-04-01, 2020-10-01-preview, 2020-04-01-preview, 2015-07-01 | 1 | any scope (MG/sub/RG/resource), inheritance, principal validation, $filter atScope()/principalId/assignedTo(); enforced on every ARM call |
| `Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions` | 2022-05-01-preview, 2022-04-01, 2018-01-01-preview, 2015-07-01 | 1 | built-in roles (well-known GUIDs) + custom roles; $filter roleName/type |
| `Microsoft.Insights/eventtypes/values` | 2017-03-01-preview, 2015-04-01 | 1 | Activity Log: GET /subscriptions/{id}/providers/Microsoft.Insights/eventtypes/management/values with $filter on eventTimestamp, resourceGroupName, resourceUri, resourceProvider, correlationId, caller |
| `Microsoft.Resources/locations` | 2024-11-01, 2024-07-01, 2024-03-01, 2023-07-01, 2022-09-01, 2021-04-01, 2020-06-01, 2019-10-01 | 1 | curated region list |
| `Microsoft.Resources/providers` | 2024-11-01, 2024-07-01, 2024-03-01, 2023-07-01, 2022-09-01, 2021-04-01, 2020-06-01, 2019-10-01 | 1 | list/get/register/unregister; every namespace reports Registered |
| `Microsoft.Resources/resourceGroups` | 2024-11-01, 2024-07-01, 2024-03-01, 2023-07-01, 2022-09-01, 2021-04-01, 2020-06-01, 2019-10-01 | 1 | create/update/patch/delete (async)/list/HEAD, tag filters, cascade delete |
| `Microsoft.Resources/resources` | 2024-11-01, 2024-07-01, 2024-03-01, 2023-07-01, 2022-09-01, 2021-04-01, 2020-06-01, 2019-10-01 | 1 | list at subscription and resource group scope ($filter resourceType, tagName/tagValue) |
| `Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions` | 2024-11-01, 2024-07-01, 2024-03-01, 2023-07-01, 2022-09-01, 2021-04-01, 2020-06-01, 2019-10-01 | 1 | get/list (filtered by RBAC visibility); seeded via seed.yaml |
| `Microsoft.Resources/tenants` | 2024-11-01, 2024-07-01, 2024-03-01, 2023-07-01, 2022-09-01, 2021-04-01, 2020-06-01, 2019-10-01 | 1 | list |

## Entra ID token service (`login.<domain>`)

| Endpoint | Notes |
|---|---|
| `/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token`, `/{tenant}/oauth2/token` | client_credentials with client secret or federated client assertion (workload identity); RS256 JWTs with tid/oid/appid/roles/groups |
| `/{tenant}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration`, `/{tenant}/discovery/v2.0/keys` | OIDC discovery + JWKS |
| `/common/discovery/instance` | MSAL instance discovery |

## Microsoft Graph subset (`graph.<domain>/v1.0` and `/beta`)

| Resource | Operations |
|---|---|
| users | list/get/create/update/delete (soft delete), lookup by UPN, memberOf/transitiveMemberOf, password complexity, verified-domain check |
| groups | list/get/create/update/delete, owners & members (`$ref`, `@odata.bind`), transitiveMembers |
| applications | list/get/create/update/delete, `applications(appId='…')`, owners, addPassword/removePassword, federatedIdentityCredentials |
| servicePrincipals | list/get/create/update/delete, `servicePrincipals(appId='…')`, owners, addPassword, appRoleAssignedTo, appRoleAssignments |
| oauth2PermissionGrants | list/get/create/update/delete |
| directoryRoles, directoryRoleTemplates | list, activate, members |
| directoryObjects | get, getByIds |
| directory/deletedItems | list by type, get, restore, permanent delete |
| organization, domains | read |

OData: `$filter` (eq, ne, startswith, in, any(), and/or/not), `$select`, `$top`, `$count`, `$orderby`, `$search` (simple), paging via `@odata.nextLink`.
Application permissions (app roles on the seeded *Microsoft Graph* service principal) are enforced and returned as `Authorization_RequestDenied` when missing.
